subject: Security collateral for AWS/GCP marketplace listings (SOC2, pen test, DPA)
messages:
From: Anna Mitchell <anna.mitchell@aws-partner.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: jeff.hale@acme-corp.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:12:03 -0700
Subject: Request: security package for AWS/GCP co-sell marketplace listing

Hi Lauren / Sergio,

We're getting close to finalizing the marketplace listing and co-sell enablement with Acme. The marketplace teams (AWS and GCP) require a short security/compliance bundle to complete their artifact checklist. Can you provide the following items so we can proceed with submission?

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent full report)
- Penetration test attestation/letter (summary ok; findings redacted is fine if necessary)
- Executed Data Processing Addendum (DPA) or a DocuSign link to sign
- A short (one-paragraph) attestation that marketplace usage won't result in customer data exposure (for listing copy)

Target timeline: ideally within 72 hours so we hit the next marketplace publication window. If any of these require legal review or redaction, let us know ETA.

Also looping in Acme procurement (Jeff) for any compliance gate questions.

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Mitchell
AWS Partner Co-sell Ops
attachments: marketplace_artifact_checklist.pdf (attachment stub)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: anna.mitchell@aws-partner.com, sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 10:05:21 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: security package for AWS/GCP co-sell marketplace listing

Thanks Anna — we can provide that. Quick plan:

- SOC 2 Type II (2025 report) — we will attach the official PDF.
- Pen test letter — we have a short attestation letter summarizing the engagement; full findings are redacted by default but we can provide an executive summary.
- DPA — attaching the current DPA draft; will send DocuSign for signature if that works for Acme.
- Attestation paragraph — will include a one-paragraph statement for the marketplace copy.

Action owners:
- Kimberly will attach the SOC2 and DPA drafts.
- Dev will pull the pen test attestation and confirm redaction status.

We expect to deliver the bundle by EOD Wednesday (2026-05-06) at the latest. If Acme needs a signed DPA sooner we can prioritize the DocuSign.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Marketplace Programs, Redwood Inference
attachments: data_processing_addendum_v3.docx (attachment stub)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 10:07:45 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: security package for AWS/GCP co-sell marketplace listing

Forwarding source request from AWS. Kimberly — please attach the SOC2 PDF and the current DPA to my reply thread. Dev — please pull the pen test attestation (redacted summary ok) and confirm whether we need legal to stamp it. Key asks below — respect redaction rules, do not include raw vulnerability data in marketplace artifacts.

Quote:
> We're getting close to finalizing the marketplace listing and co-sell enablement with Acme. The marketplace teams (AWS and GCP) require a short security/compliance bundle to complete their artifact checklist.

Deliverables and notes:
- SOC2 Type II: official PDF, signed by auditor.
- Pen test letter: short attestation, with an attached summary if we can provide a redacted findings doc (legal ok).
- DPA: send for signature; if Acme requests specific redlines note them here.

Please confirm you can hit EOD Wednesday.

—Lauren

From: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 14:22:09 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: security package for AWS/GCP co-sell marketplace listing

Lauren / Kim — I pulled the pen test attestation from last quarter. Notes:
- File: redwood_pen_test_letter_2026.pdf (attestation + summary). Full findings document is stored in S3 (s3://redwood-sec/pen-tests/2026/) and is redacted for marketplace sharing.
- The pen test vendor requires a signed NDA before full findings are shared; we will not include raw exploit data in the marketplace artifacts.
- I can produce a short attestation paragraph for the marketplace copy: “Redwood Inference undergoes annual third-party penetration testing; the latest assessment was completed in March 2026 with no critical findings that would impact marketplace operations.”

I will put the pen test attestation and the SOC2 on a secure share and confirm the DocuSign DPA link once legal signs off on the redline (1 business day).

Dev Patel
Security Engineering
attachments: redwood_pen_test_letter_2026.pdf (attachment stub)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: anna.mitchell@aws-partner.com, raj.singh@gcp-partner.com

Date: Thu, 6 May 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: security package for AWS/GCP co-sell marketplace listing

Anna / Raj — attaching the requested materials for marketplace submission and co-sell onboarding. Please find the artifacts below and let us know if you need any additional sign-offs.

Attachments (stubs):
- redwood_soc2_type2_2025.pdf — SOC 2 Type II report (auditor-signed).
- redwood_pen_test_letter_2026.pdf — pen test attestation and executive summary (redacted findings).
- data_processing_addendum_v3.docx — current DPA (we have prepared a DocuSign envelope for Acme: https://www.docusign.com/rdw-dpa-sign/xyz123)

Marketplace attestation paragraph (for listing copy):
“Redwood Inference maintains SOC 2 Type II compliance and completes annual third-party penetration testing. Customer data handled by Redwood for marketplace listings is processed under a DPA and is isolated from other tenants; no marketplace integrations expose raw customer PII.”

Notes:
- Full pen test findings require an NDA and will not be published in the marketplace artifact. If Acme or the marketplace team needs a deeper dive, we can schedule a controlled review under NDA.
- Let us know if the marketplace requires auditor contact info; we can provide it.

Next steps requested from AWS/GCP: confirm receipt and whether artifact redactions meet acceptance criteria for both marketplace portals.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Marketplace Programs, Redwood Inference
